newsitem.title: JAPAN: M'bishi Oil says operations unaffected by raid.
newsitem.headline: M'bishi Oil says operations unaffected by raid.

text.p: Mitsubishi Oil Co Ltd's business operations will not be affected by a raid on its head office by Tokyo prosecutors, a company spokesman said on Thursday.
Tokyo prosecutors raided the offices of Mitsubishi Oil earlier this morning as part of an investigation into allegations of tax evasion against an oil dealer with whom Mitsubishi has done business.
Mitsubishi Oil has denied reports that it had conducted unusual oil trades with the petroleum dealer, saying its dealings were normal business transactions.
The Osaka-based dealer operated in the domestic spot oil product market, media reports said.
Mitsubishi Oil is a major oil company involved in everything from oil exploration to retailing oil products.
